title: Please fix The bug
body:
In my opinion, the iOS Calendar application appears to have a significant flaw. Whenever I attempt to add a new event and reach the location field, the application crashes abruptly. This issue is quite problematic as it prevents me from successfully creating events with accurate location details.

As a user, I rely on the calendar app to manage my schedule efficiently, and such a recurring crash severely hampers its usability. It becomes particularly inconvenient when I need to include specific locations for my events, as I'm unable to do so without experiencing a system failure.

I believe it is crucial for the developers to address this issue promptly and release a bug fix or an update that resolves the crashing problem. Users rely on the stability and functionality of the iOS Calendar application, and this flaw significantly hinders its overall performance.

I hope the development team takes this feedback into consideration and works towards resolving this issue swiftly, ensuring a smoother and more reliable user experience in the future.
